entries.0a15d58f58b2008d: This business sells LPG (liquefied petroleum gas), LNG (liquefied natural gas) and heat. It also sells LPG appliances, performs LPG piping work, and sells coke and petroleum products. LPG sales are handled by Toho Liquefied Gas Co., Ltd. and others. Revenue from external customers for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥95,336 million, down 4.8% year on year, due to factors including lower LPG unit prices. The number of LPG customers was 646,000, and sales volume was 473,000 tonnes (down 0.2% year on year).

entries.d5d0f04d2bc7306a: In line with the medium-term management plan announced in March 2025, the company is pursuing core businesses such as city gas and LPG, along with strategic businesses such as electricity and overseas operations. In the fiscal year ended March 2026, it worked on diversifying LNG procurement regions through the start of LNG receipts from Canada, upgrading high-pressure pipelines, diversifying power sources, and expanding overseas bases in the United States and elsewhere.
entries.df01aa8f7f30730d: This business produces and sells city gas in Aichi, Mie and Gifu Prefectures, and sells gas appliances. It also includes the operation of the pipelines that deliver gas (wheeling supply) and piping work. Gas wheeling supply is handled by Toho Gas Network Co., Ltd., and the city gas business in Okayama Prefecture by Mizushima Gas Co., Ltd. Sales to external customers for the fiscal year ended March 2026 were ¥421,798 million, the largest of the 4 segments. For the fiscal year ended March 2026, the number of city gas customers was 1,759,000 and gas sales volume was 3.3 billion m3 (down 1.5% year on year).
